json_schema.title: cp.get_file
json_schema.description: Used to get a single file from the salt master

path.ui:title: Source path
path.ui:description: Salt fileserver URL to copy from (e.g. salt://path/to/file)

dest.ui:title: Destination path
dest.ui:description: Absolute path on the minion where the file should be written

makedirs.ui:title: Makedirs
makedirs.ui:description: Create destination parent directories when they do not exist

template.ui:title: Template renderer
template.ui:description: Render source/destination names with a templating engine (e.g. jinja)

gzip.ui:title: Gzip
gzip.ui:description: For larger files, the cp.get_file module also supports gzip compression. Because gzip is CPU-intensive, this should only be used in scenarios where the compression ratio is very high (e.g. pretty-printed JSON or YAML files). Use the gzip named argument to enable it. Valid values are 1..9, where 1 is the lightest compression and 9 the heaviest
